mechanics.name: Dynamic circular arena
mechanics.description: Server-controlled circular boundary that expands and contracts based on player count. Scale ranges from 0.25x to 8x. During contraction, the outer ring becomes a Danger Zone with anti-teaming penalties.

mechanics.name: Cell growth
mechanics.description: Collect food pellets (+1 mass each) and consume smaller cells. Need approximately 1.3x a target's mass to eat them, so approximately 2.6x before splitting to split-kill.

mechanics.name: Splitting
mechanics.description: Press Space to divide cell into two halves. Can split up to 16 fragments. Front half flies toward cursor at high speed. Used offensively and defensively.

mechanics.name: Mass ejection
mechanics.description: Press W to eject a small pellet (~15-16 mass) toward cursor. Used to feed teammates, shoot viruses (7 W-presses to launch, ~100-110 mass cost), or reduce mass for speed.

mechanics.name: Mass decay
mechanics.description: Cells lose approximately 0.8% of mass every 4 seconds. Bigger cells decay proportionally faster, making extreme size difficult to maintain.

mechanics.name: Viruses
mechanics.description: Spiky green circles. Big cells that touch a virus pop into ~16 pieces. Small and medium cells pass through safely. Feed 7 W-presses to shoot a virus at another player.

mechanics.name: Merge timer
mechanics.description: After splitting, cells rejoin after a timer based on mass. Bigger cells take longer to merge. Players are vulnerable until cells recombine.

mechanics.name: Ghost cells
mechanics.description: Transparent cells appear at the location where you died. Expanding Land-exclusive feature. Visible on the minimap.

mechanics.name: Server-controlled bots
mechanics.description: Arenas contain human players and server-controlled bots. In-game counters distinguish populations. Counts vary by arena and change during play.

mechanics.name: Spectator mode
mechanics.description: 200+ spectator slots with free-roam camera. Press Escape to spectate. Minimap click moves the camera in World Spectate mode.

mechanics.name: Anti-teaming system
mechanics.description: Exponential multiplier decay (Delta Server-style): base_decay × pow(1.086, multiplier). Recovery via -0.005/cycle compensation. Excessive mass sharing triggers accelerated decay.

mechanics.name: Coordinate scrambling
mechanics.description: Anti-cheat system where each connected player receives different coordinate offsets from the server, preventing external tools from sharing exact positions.
